ai.paste_title: Paste a theme made by an AI
ai.paste_help: ① ‘Copy AI prompt’ → paste it into ChatGPT, Claude… and describe the look (e.g. cherry blossom, pastel, rounded). ② Paste the whole answer here and press Apply. Don't like it? ‘Undo last theme’.

ai.err_no_vars: No theme variables (like --c1) — this doesn't look like a WidgetBoard theme

a11y.grip: {name} — arrows: move · Shift+arrows: resize · Delete: close · Menu key: menu
set.title: Settings
set.lock: Lock layout (move/resize only in edit mode)
set.hc: High contrast (strong outlines, no transparency, all buttons shown)
set.keys: Keyboard: Tab to move around · on a widget's ⋮⋮: arrows = move, Shift+arrows = resize, S = read summary, Delete = close · Menu key or Shift+F10 = right-click menu · F2 = edit item · Alt+↑/↓ in D-day = reorder · L in keyboard mode = list all
focus.on: Focus mode — only this widget is shown
kbd.on: Keyboard mode — Tab: next widget · S: summary · L: list all · Esc: leave
ov.title: Widgets as text
a11y.carrying: Widget picked up. Click again where you want to drop it (Esc cancels)
a11y.hotkey_taken: {key} is used by another program. Please pick another shortcut
hint.checklist: Click a box to finish · F2 to edit
hint.calendar: Click a day to see or add events
hint.dday: Click a row to edit · drag to reorder
hint.diary: Just type, it saves · ‹ › for other days
hint.timer: Click the digits to type a time · ▶ starts
hint.stopwatch: ▶ starts · the total keeps adding up
hint.image: Drop photos here or right-click → add
timer.caption: 🔔 Alarm ringing ({n}/{total}) — click to stop
timer.caption_muted: 🔕 Time is up (sound off) — click to dismiss
look.title: Widget appearance
look.colors: Colours for this widget (unset = follow the theme)
look.svg_big: That SVG is too large (max 100 KB)
look.svg_bad: That is not an SVG file
set.access_note: Everything here starts off. Turn on only what helps you — changes apply at once and can be turned off any time.
set.clickdrag: Move without dragging (click to pick up, click again to drop)
set.flash: Also flash the screen edge for alerts
set.notify: Also send alerts as Windows notifications
set.captions: Sound captions (show text while an alarm rings)
set.hints: Show a one-line how-to on every widget
set.short: Shorter lines in memo and diary
set.remind: Every day at this time, tell me what's left
lay.title: Layouts
lay.help: Rearranges everything at once. Widgets of the same kind keep their contents (notes, photos, settings). Widgets not in the layout are put on a shelf and come back when you switch to a layout that has them. You can always undo.
lay.work_desc: Big calendar · to-dos · memo · timer · D-days · music
lay.study_desc: Focus timer · study time total · to-dos · study diary · exam D-day · calendar
lay.name: Name (empty = date)
lay.partial: The screen is too small for some widgets; they were left out
upd.title: Updates
upd.ready: v{v} is ready — installs next time WidgetBoard starts
